title: Compose Js Graphql Read Write Segregation
description: Align compose/client/lib/js with schema.golden.graphql: Query for reads, Mutation for writes, Subscription for live operation stream. Add operation-kind assertions, split GqlTransport execute paths, unify Session mutation receipt tracking (Store backbone detach/sync). Extend embedded vitest in index.ts.
summary: Enforced GraphQL read/write segregation aligned with schema.golden.graphql: wire-kind parsing/assertions; GqlTransport executeQueryJson, executeMutationJson, subscription-checked subscribeJson; Session readEnvelope vs mutateEnvelope, subscription via GqlTransport, mutationReceipt for command correlation; executeSessionReadGraphql vs executeSessionWriteGraphql for Store/Provider/Conflict. Vitest covers wire-kind parsing.
